dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, weird. Did Mondstadters always raise boars around here?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Coming, coming! *sigh* How did this happen...?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Barbara and I were just grabbing some food at Good Hunter.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But then, uh... How do I even put this? The Sweet Madame and Sticky Honey Roast we ordered came to life!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, this boar... was the Sticky Honey Roast?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: That's right. I managed to catch the Sweet Madame earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's wrangle this thing so we can head back and eat!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: More pigeons and forest boars! The rest of our lunch is making a break for it!
